title: Foreign minister departs for Belize, Guatemala with business delegation
summary: Taipei, Sept. 27 (CNA) Taiwan's Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) departed Sunday for Belize and Guatemala with a business delegation to strengthen economic cooperation with Taiwan's two Central American diplomatic allies, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said.

title: U.S. may delay Taiwan arms sale amid more Trump-Xi meetings: Analysts
summary: Washington, Sept. 25 (CNA) The timing of a pending major U.S. arms sale to Taiwan remains uncertain after Thursday's Trump-Xi meeting at the White House, with analysts saying Washington could hold off because the two leaders are set to meet twice more this year.

title: Trump-Xi summit leaves Taiwan questions open: Experts
summary: Taipei, Sept. 26 (CNA) U.S. President Donald Trump's meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping (習近平) produced few surprises, but its implications for Taiwan will become clearer from Washington's actions after the summit, Taiwanese scholars said Saturday.

MOFA rejects Xi remarks on Taiwan during U.S. visit
summary: Taipei, Sept. 25 (CNA) Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) on Friday rejected remarks on Taiwan made by Chinese President Xi Jinping (習近平) during his state visit to the United States, accusing Beijing of "distorting facts" to advance its positions and claims.
